extraction.scope: Actual production Tiger outputs reconstructed as constructor DAGs; all selected operators, constants, parameters and function roots compared modulo allocated IDs. Identical selected DAG implies identical objective under the same cost model. No surrogate tree-size quality score or new executable runtime/interpreter test.

limits: Presence bits are auxiliary metadata, not compressed egraph storage.
Counters are candidate visits and returned logical bindings, not committed mutations.
Historical ordinary-GPU control remains faster; no end-to-end speedup claimed for these changes.
